fields.acceptance: A testscript where a question blocks an accepted change set: rhiza question answer <q> <words> --change <cs> --json makes ready drop the reason and fold-ok passes; --dry-run writes nothing; answering an unknown question exits 2; two answers to two questions get distinct handles; the roadmap app's answer path calls question.answer (Go test with a fake runner); describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: A question.answer operation answers an open question that blocks a change set by recording the owner's words as a Decision quoting them, linked answers to the question, under a free handle, in the change set it blocks; the roadmap app answers through it

fields.acceptance: inbox-blocking-questions.txtar with one run question and one model question blocking an accepted change set shows both in text and --json; after the model question is answered it is gone; a question on a draft or landed change set is never listed
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists each open question that blocks a proposed or accepted change set as a blocker item, giving the question, the change set and what it blocks, next to the run items

fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/tui/inboxapp with a fake runner asserts one question.answer call with the question, change set and typed words for a blocker item, that an answer on a run question still calls session.message, and that esc sends nothing
fields.statement: In the inbox app, typing an answer on a blocker item answers it in place through question.answer, and the item is gone on reload
